wod.title: Core Stability, Hang Power Cleans, Box Jump Overs & Shuttle Runs

parts.name: Core & Stability
parts.prescription: 15min FQ: 8 Barbell Zercher Good Mornings, 6/6 Half-Kneeling Landmine Rotational Press, 25m/25m Lateral Sled Drag

parts.name: Engine
parts.prescription: 4 x 4min amrap (1:00 rest b/t): 8 dual DB's/KB's Hang P.Clean, 8 Lateral Box Jump Overs (Step down), 100m Shuttle Run (25m x 4). Goal: same score or more in all 4 amraps

today.label: New athlete
today.fromComment: Today a new potential athlete arrives. No previous training background.

injuries.label: Ankle
injuries.fromComment: Today injured ankle will join after two weeks leave

targets.why: Landing in box jump overs and deceleration in shuttle runs
Hinging in Zercher good mornings and dual DB hang cleans
Stability for half-kneeling landmine rotational presses
Lateral sled drags and lateral box jump overs

blocks.name: General Warm-Up & Fun Drill
items: 2 rounds easy: 30s shuttle jog, 10 high knees, 10 butt kicks
Partner mirror drill: 30s lateral shuffle mirroring partner steps

blocks.name: Ankle & Hip Priming
items: 10 ankle rocks against wall per side (gentle range for returning ankles)
10 unweighted good mornings with hands behind head
8 worlds greatest stretch with thoracic rotation per side
10 lateral banded monster walks each direction

blocks.name: WOD Movement Prep
items: 5 empty bar Zercher good mornings (check brace and depth)
5 half-kneeling landmine presses per arm (light load, active core)
6 light dual DB hang muscle cleans into 6 hang power cleans
4 lateral step-overs or low box jumps with controlled step-down

rx.line: 15min FQ: 8 BB Zercher Good Mornings, 6/6 HK Landmine Rot. Press, 25m/side Lateral Sled Drag

scaled.line: 15min FQ: 8 KB Goblet Good Mornings, 6/6 HK DB Press, 20m/side Light Lateral Sled Drag

senior.line: 15min FQ: 8 Unloaded Hip Hinges, 6/6 Seated DB Strict Press, 15m/side Lateral Banded Walk

cues: Hinge back with soft knees and maintain a flat spine on good mornings.
Brace ribs down and lock in hips during the half-kneeling press.
Stay tall and resist trunk twisting during the lateral sled drag.

faults.fault: Rounding lower back in Good Morning.
faults.fix: Bend knees slightly, push hips back, and keep chest braced tight.

faults.fault: Over-arching lower back during landmine press.
faults.fix: Squeeze the trailing glute and brace the abs to maintain a neutral pelvis.

substitutions: Landmine Press -> Half-kneeling single-arm DB strict press
Lateral Sled Drag -> 20m/side lateral band walk or side-plank clamshells

rx.line: 4x4min AMRAP (1m rest): 8 Dual DB Clean @17.5/12.5kg, 8 Lat BJO (step down), 100m Shuttle Run

scaled.line: 4x4min AMRAP (1m rest): 8 Dual DB Clean @10/7.5kg, 8 Step-Overs 20", 100m Shuttle Run/Jog

senior.line: 4x4min AMRAP (1m rest): 8 Dual DB Clean @5/3kg, 8 Low Step-Overs, 60m Shuttle Walk

rxPlus.line: 4x4min AMRAP (1m rest): 8 Dual DB Clean @22.5/15kg, 8 Lat BJO 24/20", 100m Shuttle Run

cues: Pace sustainably from round 1; target equal reps in every AMRAP.
Step down from the box every rep to protect ankles and Achilles.
Jump forcefully with the hips before curling/pulling DBs to shoulders.

faults.fault: Rebounding out of box jump over, putting acute stress on ankles.
faults.fix: Always step down smoothly from the box as prescribed.

faults.fault: Pulling DBs purely with arms without hip extension.
faults.fix: Dip, aggressively extend hips and knees, then receive in a shallow dip.

substitutions: Lateral Box Jump Over -> Box Step-Over or Low Plate Hop
Shuttle Run -> 125m Row or 250m C2 Bike (low impact for ankles)

injuries.label: Ankle
injuries.warmup: Sub jogging, high knees, and lateral drill with easy bike; gentle ankle rocks only.

parts.suggestion: Sub forward sled drag/pull for lateral drag if side-to-side loading causes discomfort.
Sub low step-overs for jump-overs; sub bike or row for shuttle runs; light hang cleans.
